name: Week 34 Legs — The Bulgarian Split Squat Returns
description: The Bulgarian split squat is back, in the second slot straight after the squat. The leg press runs two sets to make room and the glute bridge leaves the warmup. RDL is 70 for all three sets, the leg curl is 80, and both hip machines run three sets. The knee-to-wall rock is a measurement day; the heel plates stay at 45 in the warmup.

dayOverview.theme: Familiar legs day with the Bulgarian split squat back right after the squat. The leg press steps down to two sets and one warmup move leaves, so the day holds its length. RDL is 70 across, the curl 80.

spotlights.why: Back after weeks away, in the second slot so it is not the last hard thing in the day. The front leg does the work and the pelvis stays level; the trunk is the lesson, not the quad.
80 is the new load. The left side goes first and sets the clean count; the right matches it.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: Spotlights go back to the squat and the RDL next.
watchpoints: 🛑 keep it shy — the cue is the cap: squat, Bulgarian split squat, barbell RDL, leg press, kneeling leg curl, hip abduction, hip adduction. Effort means the cue holding at a hard load; the ceiling is the rep the cue breaks.
🔥 near-failure last set OK: leg press calf raise. Isolation work where form holds at the limit.
**Bulgarian second, straight after the squat.** Smith at 45 with the bench, or double-50 DBs; log which. Stretch the pigeon between sets.
**RDL: 70 · 70 · 70, no light set.** Set the grip and the bar low in the fingers before the bar leaves the floor. Stop a set when grip or hinge form becomes the limiter.
**Measurement day:** the knee-to-wall rock, both sides, in fists. Last time: right 1.5, left 1.
**Leg curl 80, left first.** 70 if the left is more than two reps behind by set 2.
**Both hip machines run three sets.** Hold 2 seconds fully open on the abduction; tempo is the lever on the adduction.
**Set 1 of the squat is information, not a verdict.**
**The heel plates stay at 45 in the warmup.** Not under the working sets.
**If a hip machine is dead or mobbed, the fallback is written into the block.** Take the fallback, do not skip the slot.
**No straps on the RDL, and no flipped hand.** Double-overhand at every weight.

sets.name: Legs Warmup — Ankle First, Then the Heel-Elevated Ramp
sets.notes: The ankle work leads, because ankle range is the first limiter on depth. **The heel plates live here, at 45**, in the second ramp round.

exercises.notes: Slow up, slow down — feel the shin.

**Measurement day.** Toe to wall, knee bent, heel glued down. Slide the foot back to the furthest distance where the knee still touches the wall with the heel down, and write both numbers in fists. Last time: right 1.5, left 1.
Light band, eversion only — slow and controlled. The left one is the point.
Slow, deep, heel down on the bent side. Opens the adductors and hips before the bar; the straight leg's inner thigh is the target.
Your usual stance — the wide V, no experiments. Heels down, chest up, knees out. Note where depth stops today.
**The brace, woken deliberately.** It is half the answer to the depth question — bring it online before the bar.

**LOAD:** 45/side, two rounds.

**Round 1 — flat, 5 reps, 2-3s pause in the bottom.** The usual standard.

**Round 2 — 5lb plate under each heel, 5 reps, 2-3s pause.**
- **Use the extra room** — with the heels up there is more of it, and the point is to go there
- **Stay upright and let the knees travel forward** — that is what the elevation buys
- **Hold the brace through the pause**, ribs down
- Note whether the extra room shows up as real depth at the bottom.

sets.name: Squat — 80/Side, All Three Flat 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 80/side, 3 working sets of 6-8. **All flat — the plates stay in the warmup.**

- **Belt-tight brace** — ribs down, glutes and core braced
- Usual wide V stance
- Depth is the job, not the load: stop just above where the pelvis starts to tuck
- **Set 1 is information, not a verdict**

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 80/side, 3 sets, all flat.
- Usual wide V stance
- Belt-tight brace, ribs down, shoulders packed down
- Depth is the job, not the load
- Stop just above where the pelvis starts to tuck

sets.name: 🔆 Bulgarian Split Squat — Level Pelvis 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** Smith machine at 45 with the bench behind you, 3 sets of 8-10 each leg. **Double-50 DBs when the Smith is busy.** Log which.
Same rack area as the squat, so no walking. **Pigeon stretch between sets.**

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the trunk, not the quad:**
- **Keep the pelvis LEVEL.** The hip on the rear-leg side wants to drop; holding it up is glute medius, QL and obliques, and that is the 'core, not just legs' feeling
- **The front leg does the work.** The rear foot is balance only
- **Front shin honest** — the knee travels forward over the foot
- **Ribs down**, stacked over the front leg rather than leaning into it
- Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor

**Reflection:** does either leg fade from the first rep, and does the pelvis stay level or do you compensate with a lean?

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** Smith at 45 + bench · double-50 DBs when the Smith is busy. Log which you used. Pigeon stretch between sets.

sets.name: Barbell RDL — 70 · 70 · 70 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 70/side for all three sets, 8-10 reps, straight after the Bulgarian.

- **Double-overhand, no straps, no flipped hand** — the hands are the weakest link, and that is the point
- **Set 1 is a cold 70:** set the grip and put the bar low in the fingers, squeeze it, then lift
- **Soft knees, hips back, bar brushing the thighs**
- 3s eccentric; the set ends when the hamstrings, the grip or the position ends it

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 70/side · 70/side · 70/side.
- Double-overhand; no straps or flipped hand
- Bar low in the fingers, squeeze before you lift
- Soft knees, hips back, bar brushing the thighs
- 3s eccentric; stop when hamstrings, grip or position ends the set

sets.name: Kneeling Leg Curl — 80, Left Side First 🔆 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 80, 3 sets of 10-12 each side. Left first; match the right to the left's clean count.

- Only the lower leg moves
- Hips stay flat and square
- Slow eccentric
- On the weaker side, 2-3 seconds down
- **70 if the left is more than two reps behind by set 2**

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 80.
- Left side first and it sets the count
- Only the lower leg moves; hips flat and square
- Slow eccentric
- When the front of the hip joins in, the set is done
- Log both sides separately

sets.name: Leg Press — 4 Plates/Side, Two Sets, Knees to Chest 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side, 2 sets of 12. The calf raise follows on the same machine.

- **Deep ROM — work depth, not weight**
- **Ribs down, no leaning back**
- Knees to chest is the standard

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side, 2 sets.
- **Deep ROM** — depth, not weight
- Ribs down, no leaning back
- Knees to chest is the standard
- Slow into the bottom, no bouncing out of it

sets.name: Leg Press Calf Raise — 4 Plates/Side 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side, 3 sets of 15. **Same machine — stay where you are.**

- Balls of the feet on the bottom platform edge, heels off
- **Full controlled heel drop** — the slow stretch is the stimulus
- Press through the forefoot to a full contraction
- Knees stay soft and still
- Last set can run near failure

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side.
- Full controlled heel drop
- Press through the forefoot
- Knees soft and still

sets.name: Hip Abduction — 290, Three Sets, 2s Fully Open 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 290, 3 sets of 12-15. Hold 2 seconds with the legs fully open — the hard end of the range.

- Slow out, hold 2s fully open, slow back
- Torso quiet; no rocking

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 290. Three sets.
- Slow out
- **Hold 2 seconds with the legs fully open**
- Slow back; torso quiet, no rocking

**FALLBACK — only if the machine is dead.** Side-lying, knees bent and stacked, feet together.
- **Open the top knee slowly and hold a beat at the top**
- **The top hip must not roll backwards** — that roll is how the work escapes to the front of the hip
- Add a light band above the knees if one is around

**FALLBACK — pairs with the clamshell.** Same side-lying setup, top leg straight.
- **Lift from the side of the hip, not the front** — lead with the heel a touch, toes pointing forward, not up
- Slow up, **slower down**
- Hips stacked and still; if the torso rocks back, the range is too big

sets.name: Hip Adduction Machine — 300, Three Sets 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 300, 3 sets of 12-15.

- **Tempo is the only lever** — slow release out to a full stretch, a beat at the halfway point and another at the stretch
- Torso still

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 300. Three sets.
- **Tempo is the only lever**
- Slow release to a full stretch, a beat at the halfway point and at the stretch
- Torso still

**FALLBACK — only if the machine is occupied.** Slow, deep, heel down on the bent side.
- **Sit into one hip and let the other leg straighten fully** — the straight leg's inner thigh is the target
- Toes of the straight leg can turn up; keep the chest tall
- Hold a beat at the bottom of each rep

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Fascia/Recovery Block
sets.notes: Five minutes, every gym day. Slow breathing throughout — the downshift is as much the point as the tissue.

exercises.notes: 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
Passive. Let the shoulders decompress.
30s each side.
45s each side.
Slow breathing. End here.

tips: Bulgarian split squat is back in the second slot: pelvis level, the front leg works, pigeon between sets.
RDL is 70 · 70 · 70. Set the grip before the bar leaves the floor.
Leg curl is 80. Left first, hip square, slow eccentric. Log both sides separately.
Leg press is two sets this week; the calf raise stays at three on the same machine.
Both hip machines are three sets. Abduction 290 with 2s fully open; adduction 300.
Measure the knee-to-wall rock, both sides, in the warmup.
